questions.question: My suitcase was damaged on the flight. What are the steps?

reply.text: Tell Wizz Air ground crew at the arrival airport as soon as you notice the damage. At the airport, go to the Baggage Claim/Lost Luggage/Lost & Found desk and fill in a Property Irregularity Report (PIR), including the bag’s brand, model, value and age; you will then get a letter with further instructions. Repair the baggage and keep the receipt, as Wizz Air will cover repair costs as per applicable regulation; if it is beyond repair, get written confirmation from the repair shop including the type and value. Submit a Bag damage claim on the Wizz Air website with the PIR copy and repair-shop receipt. If you only notice the damage after leaving the airport, report it at the airport within 7 days of arrival; if the baggage is delivered damaged, you can report in writing within 21 days after delivery.
